Review_Text: I tried to return a defective Bluetooth speaker but the return portal kept rejecting my QR code. Spent 2 hours trying to resolve it. Terrible experience.
The laptop arrived with a cracked screen. Return process was straightforward but took 18 days to get my refund. Way too long.
Ordered a jacket in size L but received size S. The return label printed fine but the drop-off location said the barcode was unreadable.
Love the product but had to return it because wrong item was sent. The return took 3 weeks and I had to call support twice to chase my refund.
Returned a faulty coffee maker. The refund arrived in 4 days - genuinely impressed with how smooth the process was.
Third-party seller sent me a completely different product. Amazon support was helpful but the seller took 20 days to approve my return. Unacceptable.
Size chart was completely wrong. Returned the item easily but the return window was almost closed by the time I noticed. Need better size guidance.
The return QR code expired before I could get to a drop-off point. Had to contact support to regenerate it. Added 5 extra days to my return.
Wrong edition was sent. Return was smooth and refund came within 3 days. Amazon handled this really well.
The product stopped working after 2 weeks. Tried to return it but the system said it was outside the return window even though it was defective.
Returned a duplicate order. The process was easy but I received only a partial refund with no explanation. Still waiting for the remaining amount.
The return drop-off near me stopped accepting Amazon returns with no notice. Had to drive 20 miles to find another location.
Bought for my child but it was not as described. Return was quick and painless. Very satisfied with the resolution.
I returned an item 3 weeks ago and have not received my refund yet. Support keeps telling me it is being processed. This is unacceptable for a Prime member.
The seller refused my return request even though the item was defective. Amazon stepped in but the whole process took 25 days.
Returned a dress that was not true to colour. The return was simple and the refund was in my account within 2 days. Great service.
Tried to return a broken blender but the return option was greyed out in my account. Could not figure out why. Had to call customer service.
The laptop I returned was received by Amazon but I got a refund for a lower amount than I paid. No explanation was given.
Ordered two items and returned one. The refund only covered one item even though I returned both. Still chasing the second refund after 2 weeks.
Great experience returning a damaged book. Fast refund and helpful support agent. Would shop here again without hesitation.
My return was rejected because the seller claimed the item was not in its original condition. It absolutely was. Amazon sided with the seller.
The automated return system does not handle custom or oversized items well. I had to call three times before someone could process my return manually.
Return was simple and the refund was fast. However the return packaging instructions were confusing and I almost voided my return by mistake.
Waited 22 days for a refund on a returned phone. I had to escalate to a supervisor before anything happened. Completely unacceptable.
Returned a toy that was missing parts. Support was responsive and the replacement arrived before my refund was even processed. Excellent service.
